hook: Three people stranded on a roof deck after Hurricane Ian.
narration: She rode a steel basket up off a roof, high over Sanibel Island.
Hurricane Ian had just torn through, and three people were stranded there.
A Coast Guard Dolphin crew from Air Station Miami hovered over the house.
The flight mechanic leans out the door and steers the cable with one gloved hand.
One by one, the swimmer sent them up, and rode the last one up himself.
outcome: The Miami crew lifted all three off Sanibel Island.
title: Basket ride over Sanibel after Hurricane Ian
description:
A Coast Guard MH-65 Dolphin aircrew from Air Station Miami rescued three people stranded on Sanibel Island, Florida, after Hurricane Ian in late September 2022.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 2nd Class Spencer Riegel, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/859335/coast-guard-rescues-3-stranded-people-sanibel-island-florida
